claim: MGM Grand fire, Las Vegas, Nov 21, 1980: 85 killed (some sources 84/87). Casino, restaurant (incl. the deli where it started) and most of the 26-storey hotel had no sprinklers. Full sprinklering would have cost ~ $192,000 on a $106 million resort. NFPA report co-author David Demers: 'With sprinklers, it would have been a one- or two-sprinkler fire and we never would have heard about it.' Nevada mandated sprinklers in buildings over 55 ft about five months later.
